text: 1.Photocopy of the passportThe passport must have an expiry date after September of the year you apply, if the validity of the applicant's current passport does not meet the requirement, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applican3. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.4. Photocopy of Physical Examination Record.Applicants should strictly check the items in accordance with the requirements of Physical Examination Record.pdf Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending doctor, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The date shall be after October 1, 2023. The original piece is required during registration.5. Self-introduction videoApplicants are required to upload a video of self-introduction within one minute, and those who have HSK certificates must use Chinese to introduce themselves.6.Original or copy document of the highest diploma (afternotarization).If the applicant is currently a student, the pre-graduation certificate issued by the school is required. Non-Chinese/English documents must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.7.Original or copy document of the mark sheetStamped Transcript from the undergraduate/master program or notarized Chinese/English-translated transcript. Those transcripts shall be issued and sealed by the attending university's academic affairs office, graduate school, or student management department.8.Recommendation letters of 2 professors or associate professorsThe signature date shall be after October 1, 2023.9.Study Plan of no less than 1000 words.Please clarify your research background, method, content, significance, etc.10. CV letter11. Valid HSK Transcript for Chinese-taught programs and IELTS\TOEFL for English-taught programs(or other documents to prove your linguistic competence.)12. published essays, or any other supporting materials.13. family financial proof certificate (or one year bank statement) 14. Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.
